scope: single-run four-route fresh-category UI/log controlled-mutation replication; not production adjudication and not a translation-origin factorial

services: Anthropic first-party via Claude Code CLI
Z.ai CN via Pi custom provider
authorization.basis: The user explicitly requested one small replication after approving these four active routes and retiring Fable/Advisor for budget reasons.
authorization.data_scope: 8 sanitized UI/log source-target-context records from the existing corpus; no credentials, historical verdicts, mutation labels, model provenance or local absolute paths are sent

route_policy.historical_artifact_policy: Retired-route historical artifacts remain preserved but are outside this experiment.

source_verification.policy: All eight full baselines are bound to inspected source files. One malformed historical placeholder composition is corrected in the fixture before control assignment and is not a production edit.

prompt.relationship_to_v1: same verdict and evidence contract; mechanical item count changed 24 to 8 and UI/log resource identity added to focus

output_schema.enforcement: CLI schema where supported plus exact-order local validation

routes.runtime_identity_rule: all assistant review messages must be claude-opus-5 and fallback count zero

routes.availability_check: agy models listed gemini-3.7-flash-high immediately before freezing
routes.runtime_identity_limitation: agy JSON envelope does not expose model identity

preregistered_analysis.primary: mutation-specific detection recall: a non-OK response counts only when its atomic claim matches the sealed injected mutation
secondary: source-refuted false positives on the four directly verified controls
union, four-route consensus and missed-mutation identity
comparison with v1 is descriptive because categories and sample sizes differ
not_allowed: count every non-OK mutant response as a hit without atomic-claim matching
expose sealed files or route outputs before all independent runs complete
infer stable rankings or variance from this single four-mutation replication
treat the fixture-only Startling Shot repair as a production translation change
preregistered_analysis.success_gate: The replication is informative if it completes without control contamination and reveals whether v1's near-ceiling mutation recall persists on the fresh UI/log category.
